text:
anya: Spotting a cluster of 413s on /v1/embeddings for large batched requests (~25k dims). Clients get a hard reject.

carlos: Preflight is strict on max_bytes. Proposal: accept-then-split path. Router returns 202 + `X-Embed-Estimate` and enqueues a shardizer which emits shards within grace_ms. If shardizer fails, router replies 413.

mika: Telemetry must capture: embed.accept_split_attempt, embed.split_success, embed.split_fail, embed.fallback_routed. Attach tags: tenant_id, shard_count, orig_bytes, final_bytes, route_latency_ms. Also emit gauge embed.accept_inflight.

anya: Console needs a FF `embed_accept_split_v1` and a usage tile showing split_rate, fallback_rate, and an estimated cost delta when enabled. Link to sample scrubbed payloads.

carlos: Config idea:
{ "policy":"accept_then_split", "grace_ms":200, "max_shards":6, "fallback_pool":"cpu-lowfi" }

mika: Runtime notes: keep KV cache prefix deterministic across shards (parent_prefix) so cache hits don't break. And billing must emit one parent billing event at acceptance, reconcile final units when shards finish.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: feature flag `embed_accept_split_v1` canary started to 1% tenants (deploy id: dpl-2026-03-21-11).

anya: Rollout plan: 1% for 24h, watch split_fail and fallback_routed + p95 latency; 10% for 48h if healthy, full after a week. Action: carlos implement runtime & shardizer; mika add telemetry + alerts; i'll draft rollout doc and console tile.
